text: I was on holiday in Phuket when a crown on one of my molars got dislodged. Our hotel concierge recommended this studio, and it was an excellent suggestion. The studio is clean and peaceful, with cold drinking water available in the waiting room. The staff speak English and are friendly. I was seen by Dr. Hatsumol, who was incredibly gentle when fixing my tooth; I felt no pain at all. I really appreciated that she explained everything she was doing. She did an X-ray right there in the dental chair, which was so convenient, and I was done in 30 minutes. The price was very reasonable too, only 2300THB for everything. Highly recommended! (P.S. As with many places in Thailand, patients just remove their shoes before entering. If you are not comfortable in bare feet, then you may want to bring a pair of socks with you.)

text: This is my second visit. My husband had a toothache and had a tooth extracted here. The doctor scheduled a follow-up appointment to remove the stitches. The first time I came, the counter staff were very helpful. Today, I'm disappointed because I chose this clinic based on a friend's recommendation, and the doctor is skilled. My husband told me he didn't feel any pain during the extraction. However, one of the counter staff members was unfriendly and showed a displeased expression when I inquired about my next appointment. She seemed unwilling to provide service, even though there was nothing wrong during the first visit. We barely spoke, except when I handed over the payment. On this second visit, I had appointments for both my husband and son at the same time. The same staff member couldn't find our appointments even though I gave them our names. My husband was seen on time because another staff member found him, but my son still hadn't been seen by the same staff member after waiting 40 minutes. When we discussed the next appointment, we asked the assistant or doctor (I'm not sure which) to clarify things, as this staff member wasn't being clear with the patients. She wanted me to decide whether to have a scaling or filling done at the next appointment, even though I asked if a filling was possible since the tooth was recently extracted and I wasn't sure if it would affect the gums. She just said, "That's why you need to consult the doctor first." "Why did you ask if I wanted a scraping or a filling? How could you tell me correctly? You should consult the doctor next week to see if it's possible, but you need an answer about the appointment now – what exactly are you going to do next week?" This confused the patient, and the staff member even made a face at her. After finishing her husband's appointment, she sat waiting for her son's appointment. While the patients were waiting at the counter, the staff member who made the face whispered to the other staff member who was helping with the appointments, and I overheard it. It was like, "Um, customers come to use your services, they're paying you, and they're not causing any trouble. Is it appropriate for you to treat them like this?" Everything I've written isn't about a competing clinic or a fake review. If you want proof of my service, I can show it. Bad service from just one person can ruin the whole organization. If you're not ready, or have personal problems, you should take time off work. You shouldn't take it out on customers. She didn't just make a face at me; she did it to almost every customer. It's terrible. I'm giving a 1-star review because the doctor is skilled; everything else is not okay.
